title: Chapter 103 Blue And White Python
content:
Chapter 103 Blue And White Python

After hearing Wang Shuo's order, the militia team took quick action and held Man Niu back.

Gong Ping and Gong Kai started fighting with the spider.

Gu Liji and Baili Liang fought with a giant ape.

The two most ferocious silver bosses are dealt with by Ayub and Gong Zheng.

The remaining ones are one golden-armored warrior and one Wang Shuo.

[White Wolf King (ID: Wolf 11038 Bai Ming, Silver Boss)]

[Level: Level 23]

[Attack power: 490]

[Defense: 100]

[Health value: 10000]

[Skills: Claw attack, bone crushing, bite. 】

Ayub's level has been upgraded to level 26, and various attributes have also been greatly improved to cope with the level 23 White Wolf King.

Wang Shuo also had some drumming in his heart.

After all, the White Wolf King's attack power is as high as 490 points.

At this moment, Wang Shuo discovered that Dongfang Ling was still outside.

"Dongfang Ling, you don't want your life, go back to the inner wall!" Wang Shuo scolded with an angry look on his face.

At this moment, he had no intention of taking care of this guest's emotions.

"Stop looking down on others. I will definitely live longer than you. You'd better take care of yourself!" Dongfang Ling was a little unconvinced and argued with a red face.

She also looked nervously at the bosses and monsters around her, without even looking at Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo wanted to say something more, but the boss in front of him would not give him a chance to chat.

A blue and white python that was more than 10 meters long raised its head upright and spat out a letter to Wang Shuo.

The python has a bright red crown on its head, which seems to be able to squeeze out blood.

The thick body is over 1 meter in diameter.

She kept circling around Wang Shuo while staring straight at Wang Shuo, as if thinking about where to start.

"Human, human, delicious, cluck, cluck, cluck..." The blue and white python giggled in a soft girlish voice.

Wang Shuo's hair stood on end, and he became alert.

He has always had a hard time accepting the fact that these bosses can talk.

Some of the bronze bosses he encountered before were unable to speak.

Obviously, this is related to their low levels and attributes.

Wang Shuo snorted coldly and waved his spear: "How dare you be so unruly as a little evil beast."

After saying that, he held the gun in both hands, took a step back with his right foot, and was ready to attack.

As the snake head kept circling around him, Wang Shuo had to stare at the snake head and spin along with it.

Suddenly, the python poked its head out, opened its huge mouth, exposed its sharp fangs, and bit Wang Shuo's head fiercely.

Wang Shuo has experienced a lot of battles, so he did not panic when faced with this situation.

Instead of retreating, he advanced, holding the spear tightly with both hands, and pointed it at the snake's head.

The blue and white python obviously knew how powerful the spear was, just when her tongue was about to touch Wang Shuo.

The spear was about to hit her throat.

She wisely chose to give up attacking Wang Shuo and tilted her head to avoid the attack.

Wang Shuo also narrowly escaped the fate of being swept away by the tongue.

The python failed to hit the target and immediately moved towards Wang Shuo with its body, trying to trap Wang Shuo.

The python's body was originally surrounding Wang Shuo. Now it kept narrowing the area and was about to tie up Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo had no choice but to point his spear at the ground and jump into the air with the help of the huge rebound force.

But this gave the python an opportunity.

The snake spit out the letter and attacked Wang Shuo again.

The bright red and slender snake letter is divided into two branches at the front, like an open whip. If you look closely, you can see that there are barbs all over it.

If you are hit, you will not only be injured, but you may even be tied up and swallowed by a python.

Wang Shuo was horrified. There was no point of focus in the air, so he had no choice but to use his spear to point at Snake Xin.

In this way, Wang Shuo's flame spear was directly caught in the python's tongue.

Wang Shuo panicked.

At this moment, he suddenly got wise and took out a thunderbolt, and threw it in while the snake's mouth was wide open.

"Bang"

A loud noise sounded from the python's mouth.

Although it only caused 500 points of damage, it successfully injured the python's tongue.
